split: apprentice replicate cohorts; clusters are people (cohort label + person id)
note: Apprentice cohorts from our own generator (8 experts, 16 novices, 2 cases each, planted deficits with exact prices): fresh seeds of the same generator. They show recovery of what we planted, and cannot show that a method avoided learning the generator.

stress_test.note: Invented stress test: the true prices are additive plus one planted interaction. The single-habit replays double-count the interaction (each habit's replay includes all of it), so they sum to more than the total; the Shapley allocation shares it and sums to the total.

oaxaca_blinder_cohort_level.note: cohort-level behaviour-count decomposition; not comparable case by case with the replay

assumption: The counterfactual assumes the rest of the path would be unchanged when the habit is fixed; it fails when habits interact.
